keyFindings.description: With the pane on, Enter's `when` (767-771) never checks where the focus is, so Enter on any list control (a row's owner link, Later (n), the bulk bar, filter controls) is preventDefault'ed and focus jumps into the pane's answer box. Regression from the old `inFocusedRow` guard; probe: `ENTER default prevented: true focus now: TEXTAREA`.

In a document with several open decision blocks, `hand()` is the whole pane, so 1-9 (780) and Enter (756-759) act on the FIRST block's AskCard in DOM order, not the selected ask's: ProofDocument hosts an answerable AskBlockCard with `hotkey` options for every open block (ProofDocument.tsx:934-946, AskCard.tsx:670). A reader can tick an option of the wrong decision.

startChanging writes the recorded answer's text into the new shared draft store (304) and cancelChanging (308-312) never clears it, so after Change answer -> Cancel, `unsentAnswer` (418) is the reader's own recorded answer and the card shows 'This question closed before you sent your answer' on every surface for that ask; the leftover draft also holds the question in the pane.

textRuns (70-82) counts only text nodes, while change-marks.ts reads offsets from `block.textContent`, which counts a hard break's leafText '\n'; every mark after a hard break is shifted one character per break (probe: `canary` drawn over 'anary ').

diffWordsWithSpace (81) runs unbounded on every changed pair, and lists, tables and fenced code blocks are now one block each; two unrelated 3000-word blocks take ~8 s on the main thread (benchmark), where VersionDiff's diffLines cost ~one token per line. Bound it (maxEditLength/timeout) and fall back to whole-block removed/added.
packages/dispatch has no .changie.yaml, so nothing folds this fragment, and the root AGENTS.md forbids a Dispatch issue key in a fragment's file name and Issue field. Delete it.

`fold?: boolean` and its branch have no production caller (only ChangeView.test.tsx passes fold={false}); change-set.ts:7 and AGENTS.md:558 claim both surfaces 'mark the same words' though ChangeView pairs markdown source and change-marks pairs rendered textContent; AGENTS.md:558 says 'the one view ... the only one' beside the second mechanism; AGENTS.md:560 says 'three classes' and lists four.
Copies reply-drafts.ts line for line (store map, listeners, setter, useSyncExternalStore hook, reset). One keyed draft store for both.
NOTE_DISCLOSURE_SELECTOR (91) finds the note disclosure by an aria-controls id suffix; use a data-ask-note-disclosure attribute as data-ask-answer/data-ask-option do.

Inbox.tsx grows 878 -> 1208 lines with the selection (selectedNow, shownItem, paneSubject, paneAsk, nextAfterSelected, the ?item= and scroll effects) written inline and `paneShown ?` ternaries in most bindings; move the selection into a usePaneSelection hook and choose move/noun once.
InboxItem (119-284) uses `onSelect !== undefined` as a mode switch between two unrelated layouts; split into a short row and a card row sharing the <li> wrapper.
Two flows in one component chosen by subject.kind about ten times (queries, effects, VersionView vs ProofDocument); split into ApprovalBody and DecisionBody under the shared ReadingPaneHead.

The pane surface is spelled three ways (inPane, surfaceRef.current === 'pane', local pane) across ~17 sites; surfaceRef exists only to keep a never-changing prop out of effect deps. One `page` const in the deps.
New props onAskAnswered and surface are passed by no caller (DocumentPage.tsx:147, IssuePage.tsx:397, :455); ReadingPane mounts ProofDocument directly. Delete them.
The ['artifact', id, 'text'] query (190-197) is written by hand beside ProofDocument's liveTextQueryOptions; reuse it.
